summary: Example [ce:vars] for NETCONF uses ansible.netcommon.netconf with community.network.ce, user, vaulted password and optional proxy command.
questions: What inventory settings do I need for CloudEngine over NETCONF?

answer_card.title: CloudEngine NETCONF inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[ce:vars]
ansible_connection=ansible.netcommon.netconf
ansible_network_os=community.network.ce
ansible_user=myuser
ansible_password=!vault |
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command='-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
